Delta k: Spread of the wave numbers in the packet (RMS, weighted by aₙ²)
Delta x: Width of the packet (RMS width of its squared envelope)
a_ref: Amplitude of the strongest partial (the 0 dB reference)
k_n: Wave number of harmonic n, n k₁
lambda_1: Wavelength of the fundamental in air
n_0: Harmonic at the center of the wave packet
sigma: Spread of the wave packet, in harmonics
